title: Quantum Claims Evidence Passport: An Offline Audit of a Swiss Quantum Hub Announcement and a Modeled 613 THz Anesthetic/Microtubule Frequency Band
description:
Quantum Claims Evidence Passport is an original, offline Python CLI and static HTML report for claims audit and scientific communication. It separates an institutional announcement and future deployment plan from computational/theoretical modeling, animal behavioral evidence, hypotheses, and unsupported inferences, without combining them into a score.

The 2017 source's 613 ± 8 THz notation is described as a modeled/reported frequency band, not a direct measurement or a statistical confidence interval. The cited 2024 within-subject study involved eight male Long–Evans rats (N=8) and used loss-of-righting-reflex (LORR) latency as a behavioral proxy under 4% isoflurane; it reported a mean delay of about +69 s (p=0.0016). That study did not measure 613 THz or establish a quantum-consciousness mechanism, human outcomes, or clinical advice.

Includes cited factual summaries, source links, reproducible exact-SI frequency conversions, an original SVG evidence-class visual, fail-closed validation, and standard-library tests. No paper text or figure, screenshots, logos, or third-party images are copied. No affiliation with IBM, Lockheed Martin, ETH Zurich, or CSCS is implied. Not medical, scientific, or investment advice. Audit snapshot: 2026-10-05.
